pli-tv-kd18:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āgantukā bhikkhū saupāhanāpi ārāmaṃ pavisanti chattapaggahitāpi ārāmaṃ pavisanti oguṇṭhitāpi ārāmaṃ pavisanti sīse pi cīvaraṃ karitvā ārāmaṃ pavisanti pāniyena pi pāde dhovanti vuḍḍhatare pi āvāsike bhikkhū na abhivādenti na senāsanaṃ pucchanti,
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.3: aññataro pi āgantuko bhikkhu anajjhāvutthaṃ vihāraṃ ghaṭikaṃ ugghāṭetvā kavāṭaṃ paṇāmetvā sahasā pāvisi,
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.6: bhikkhū upadhāvitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.8: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.9: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.10: kathaṃ hi nāma āgantukā bhikkhū saupāhanāpi ārāmaṃ pavisissanti chattapaggahitāpi ārāmaṃ pavisissanti . . . pāniyena pi pāde dhovissanti vuḍḍhatare pi āvāsike bhikkhū na abhivādessanti na senāsanaṃ pucchissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.11: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.12: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave āgantukā bhikkhū saupāhanāpi ārāmaṃ pavisanti chattapaggahitāpi . . . na senāsanaṃ pucchantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.15: hi nāma bhikkhave āgantukā bhikkhū saupāhanāpi ārāmaṃ pavisissanti . . . pucchissanti. n' etaṃ bhikkhave . . .
pli-tv-kd18:1.1.18: tena hi bhikkhave āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā āgantukehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.1: āgantukena bhikkhave bhikkhunā idāni ārāmaṃ pavisissāmīti upāhanā omuñcitvā nīcaṃ katvā pappoṭhetvā gahetvā chattaṃ apanāmetvā sīsaṃ vivaritvā cīvaraṃ khandhe karitvā sādhukaṃ ataramānena ārāmo pavisitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.5: upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.11: sace pāniyena attho hoti pāniyaṃ gahetvā pātabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.12: sace paribhojaniyena attho hoti paribhojaniyaṃ gahetvā pādā dhovitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.13: pāde dhovantena ekena hatthena udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ ekena hatthena pādā dhovitabbā,
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.14: na ten' eva hatthena udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ na ten' eva hatthena pādā dhovitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.16: upāhanā puñchantena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena colakena puñchitabbā pacchā allena,
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.18: sace āvāsiko bhikkhu vuḍḍho hoti abhivādetabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.20: senāsanaṃ pucchitabbaṃ katamaṃ me senāsanaṃ pāpuṇātīti,
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.21: ajjhāvutthaṃ vā anajjhāvutthaṃ vā pucchitabbaṃ, gocaro pucchitabbo, agocaro pucchitabbo, sekhasammatāni kulāni pucchitabbāni, vaccaṭṭhānaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, passāvaṭṭhānaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, pāniyaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, paribhojaniyaṃ pucchitabbaṃ, kattaradaṇḍo pucchitabbo, saṃghassa katikasaṇṭhānaṃ pucchitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:1.2.22: kaṃ kālaṃ pavisitabbaṃ kaṃ kālaṃ nikkhamitabban ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.1: sace vihāro anajjhāvuttho hoti, kavāṭaṃ ākoṭetvā muhuttaṃ āgametvā ghaṭikaṃ ugghāṭetvā kavāṭaṃ paṇāmetvā bahi ṭhitena nilloketabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.2: sace so vihāro uklāpo hoti mañce vā mañco āropito hoti pīṭhe vā pīṭhaṃ āropitaṃ hoti senāsanaṃ uparipuñjakitaṃ hoti, sace ussahati sodhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.3: vihāraṃ sodhentena paṭhamaṃ bhummattharaṇaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.7: mañco nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.8: pīṭhaṃ nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.11: sace vihāre santānakaṃ hoti, ullokā paṭhamaṃ ohāretabbaṃ. ālokasandhikaṇṇabhāgā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.12: sace gerukaparikammakatā bhitti kaṇṇakitā hoti, colakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.13: sace kāḷavaṇṇakatā bhūmi kaṇṇakitā hoti, colakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.3.14: sace akatā hoti bhūmi, udakena parippositvā sammajjitabbā
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.1: bhummattharaṇaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.2: mañcapaṭipādakā otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ ṭhapetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.3: mañco otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ paññāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.4: pīṭhaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.5: bhisibimbohanaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.6: nisīdanapaccattharaṇaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.7: kheḷamallako otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ ṭhapetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.4.8: apassenaphalakaṃ otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathābhāgaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ. ||4||
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.2: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.3: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.4: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.5: sace puratthimā sarajā vātā vāyanti, puratthimā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.8: sace dakkhiṇā sarajā vātā vāyanti, dakkhiṇā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.9: sace sītakālo hoti, divā vātapānā vivaritabbā rattiṃ thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.10: sace uṇhakālo hoti, divā vātapānā thaketabbā rattiṃ vivaritabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.11: sace pariveṇaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, pariveṇaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.12: sace koṭṭhako uklāpo hoti, koṭṭhako sammajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.13: sace upaṭṭhānasālā uklāpo hoti, upaṭṭhānasālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.14: sace aggisālā uklāpā hoti, aggisālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.15: sace vaccakuṭī uklāpā hoti, vaccakuṭī sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.16: sace pāniyaṃ na hoti, pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.17: sace paribhojaniyaṃ na hot, paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.18: sace ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:1.5.19: idaṃ kho bhikkhave āgantukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ yathā āgantukehi bhikkhūhi vattitabban ti. ||5||1||
pli-tv-kd18:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āvāsikā bhikkhū āgantuke bhikkhū disvā n' eva āsannaṃ paññāpenti, na pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipanti, na paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭigaṇhanti, na pāniyena pucchanti, vuḍḍhatare pi āgantuke bhikkhū na abhivādenti, na senāsanaṃ paññāpenti.
pli-tv-kd18:2.1.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd18:2.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma āvāsikā bhikkhū āgantuke bhikkhū disvā n' eva āsanaṃ paññāpessanti . . . na senāsanaṃ paññāpessantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:2.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:2.1.9: tena hi bhikkhave āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:2.2.1: āvāsikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā āgantukaṃ bhikkhuṃ vuḍḍhataraṃ disvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, pāniyena pucchitabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:2.2.3: upāhanā puñchantena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena colakena puñchitabbā pacchā allena,
pli-tv-kd18:2.2.18: imaṃ kālaṃ pavisitabbaṃ imaṃ kālaṃ nikkhamitabban ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:2.3.1: sace navako hoti nisinnaken' eva ācikkhitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:2.3.2: atra pattaṃ nikkhipāhi atra cīvaraṃ nikkhipāhi idaṃ āsanaṃ nisīdāhīti.
pli-tv-kd18:2.3.20: idaṃ kho bhikkhave āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ yathā āvāsikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabban ti. ||3||2||
pli-tv-kd18:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena gamikā bhikkhū dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ apaṭisāmetvā dvāravātapānaṃ vivaritvā senāsanaṃ anāpucchā pakkamanti,
pli-tv-kd18:3.1.5: kathañ hi nāma gamikā bhikkhū . . . pakkamissanti,
pli-tv-kd18:3.1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:3.1.13: tena hi bhikkhave gamikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā gamikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:3.2.1: gamikena bhikkhave bhikkhunā dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ paṭisāmetvā dvāravātapānaṃ thaketvā senāsanaṃ āpucchā pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:3.2.2: sace bhikkhu na hoti, sāmaṇero āpucchitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:3.2.3: sace sāmaṇero na hoti, ārāmiko āpucchitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:3.2.5: na hoti bhikkhu vā sāmaṇero vā ārāmiko vā, catūsu pāsāṇakesu mañcaṃ paññāpetvā, mañce mañcaṃ āropetvā, pīṭhe pīṭhaṃ āropetvā, senāsanaṃ uparipuñjaṃ karitvā, dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ paṭisāmetvā, dvāravātapānaṃ thaketvā pakkamitabbaṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.1: sace vihāro ovassati, sace ussahati chādetabbo, ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.3: evañ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.4: no ce labhetha yo deso anovassako hoti tattha catūsu pāsāṇakesu mañcaṃ paññāpetvā, mañce mañcaṃ āropetvā, pīṭhe pīṭhaṃ āropetvā, senāsanaṃ uparipuñjaṃ karitvā, dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṇḍaṃ paṭisāmetvā, dvāravātapānaṃ thaketvā pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.5: sace sabbo vihāro ovassati, sace ussahati senāsanaṃ gāmaṃ atiharitabbaṃ, ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.6: kinti nu kho senāsanaṃ gāmaṃ atihariyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.7: evañ ce taṃ labhetha icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.8: no ce labhetha ajjhokāse catūsu pāsāṇakesu mañcaṃ paññāpetvā, mañce mañcaṃ āropetvā, pīṭhe pīṭhaṃ āropetvā, senāsanaṃ uparipuñjaṃ karitvā, dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ paṭisāmetvā, tiṇena vā paṇṇena vā paṭicchādetvā pakkamitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.9: app' eva nāma aṅgāni pi seseyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd18:3.3.10: idaṃ kho bhikkhave gamikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ yathā gamikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabban ti. ||3||3||
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhattagge na anumodanti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā bhattagge na anumodissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.9: kena nu kho bhattagge anumoditabban ti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.11: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.12: anujānāmi bhikkhave therena bhikkhunā bhattagge anumoditun ti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.13: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghabhattaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.16: bhagavatā anuññātaṃ therena bhikkhunā bhattagge anumoditun ti
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.18: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto te manusse paṭisammoditvā pacchā ekako agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.19: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.23: api ca maṃ bhikkhū ekakaṃ ohāya pakkantā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.24: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.25: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhattagge catūhi pañcahi therānutherehi bhikkhūhi āgametun ti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.26: tena kho pana samayena aññataro thero bhattagge vaccito āgamesi,
pli-tv-kd18:4.1.29: anujānāmi bhikkhave sati karaṇīye ānantarikaṃ bhikkhuṃ āpucchitvā gantun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā bhattaggaṃ gacchanti, vokkamma pi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato-purato gacchanti, there pi bhikkhū anupakhajja nisīdanti, nave pi bhikkhū āsanena paṭibāhanti, saṃghāṭim pi ottharitvā antaraghare nisīdanti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.2.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd18:4.2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dunnivatthā . . . gacchissanti . . . nisīdissanti . . . paṭibāhissanti . . . nisīdissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.2.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:4.2.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū dunnivatthā . . . nisīdantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.2.9: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ bhattaggavattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā bhikkhūhi bhattagge vattitabbaṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:4.3.1: sace ārāme kālo ārocito hoti timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetvā, kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā, saguṇaṃ katvā, saṃghāṭiyo pārupitvā, gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcitvā, dhovitvā, pattaṃ gahetvā, sādhukaṃ ataramānena gāmo pavisitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:4.3.2: na vokkamma therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato-purato gantabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.1: udake diyyamāne ubhohi hatthehi pattaṃ parigahetvā udakaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.2: nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena patto dhovitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.3: sace udakapaṭiggāhako hoti, nīcaṃ katvā udakapaṭiggahe udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.4: mā udakapaṭiggāhako udakena osiñci mā sāmantā bhikkhū udakena osiñciṃsu mā saṃghāṭi udakena osiñcīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.5: sace udakapaṭiggāhako na hoti, nīcaṃ katvā chamāya udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.6: mā sāmantā bhikkhū udakena osiñciṃsu mā saṃghāṭi udakena osiñcīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.7: odane diyyamāne ubhohi hatthehi pattaṃ pariggahetvā odano paṭiggahetabbo. sūpassa okāso kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.8: sace hoti sappi vā telaṃ vā uttaribhaṅgaṃ vā, therena vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd18:4.4.14: na tāva therena bhuñjitabbaṃ yāva na sabbesaṃ odano sampanno hoti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd18:4.5.6: na sūpaṃ vā vyañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādetabbaṃ bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya,
pli-tv-kd18:4.5.7: na sīpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilānena attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:4.5.12: na bhuñjamānena sabbo hattho mukhe pakkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.1: na tāva therena udakaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ yāva na sabbe bhuttāvino honti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.2: udake diyyamāne ubhohi hatthehi pattaṃ pariggahetvā udakaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.3: nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena patto dhovitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.4: sace udakapaṭiggāhako hoti, nīcaṃ katvā udakapaṭiggahe udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.5: mā udakapaṭiggāhako udakena osiñci mā sāmantā bhikkhū udakena osiñciṃsu mā saṃghāṭi udakena osiñcīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.6: sace udakapaṭiggāhako na hoti, nīcaṃ katvā chamāya udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.7: mā sāmantā bhikkhū udakena osiñciṃsu mā saṃghāṭi udakena osiñcīti.
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.9: nivattantena navakehi bhikkhūhi paṭhamataraṃ nivattitabbaṃ pacchā therehi.
pli-tv-kd18:4.6.22: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ bhattaggavattaṃ yathā bhikkhūhi bhattagge vattitabban ti. ||6||4||
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena piṇḍacārikā bhikkhū dunnivatthā duppārutā anākappasampannā piṇḍāya caranti, asallakkhetvāpi nivesanaṃ pavisanti, asallakkhetvāpi nikkhamanti, atisahasāpi pavisanti, atisahasāpi nikkhamanti, atidūre pi tiṭṭhanti, accāsanne pi tiṭṭhanti, aticiram pi tiṭṭhanti, atilahukam pi nivattanti.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.2: aññataro pi piṇḍacāriko bhikkhu asallakkhetvā nivesanaṃ pāvisi,
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.3: so dvāraṃ maññamāno aññataraṃ ovarakaṃ pāvisi,
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.4: tasmiṃ ovarake itthi naggā uttānā nipannā hoti.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.5: addasā kho so bhikkhu taṃ itthiṃ naggaṃ uttānaṃ nipannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.7: na yidaṃ dvāraṃ ovarakaṃ idan ti tamhā ovarakā nikkhami.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.8: addasā kho tassā itthiyā sāmiko taṃ itthiṃ naggaṃ uttānaṃ nipannaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.10: iminā me bhikkhunā pajāpatī dūsitā 'ti taṃ bhikkhuṃ gahetvā ākoṭesi.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.11: atha kho sā itthi tena saddena paṭibujjhitvā taṃ purisaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.12: kissa tvaṃ ayyo imaṃ bhikkhuṃ ākoṭesīti.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.15: akārako so bhikkhū 'ti taṃ bhikkhuṃ muñcāpesi.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.16: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.17: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma piṇḍacārikā bhikkhū dunnivatthā . . . carissanti . . . pavisissanti . . . nikkhamissanti . . . tiṭṭhissanti . . . atilahukam pi nivattissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.19: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.1.24: tena hi bhikkhave piṇḍacārikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā piṇḍacārikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:5.2.2: idāni gāmaṃ pavisissāmīti timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetvā, kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā, saguṇaṃ katvā, saṃghāṭiyo pārupitvā, gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcitvā, dhovitvā, pattaṃ gahetvā, sādhukaṃ ataramānena gāmo pavisitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:5.2.25: sace kammaṃ vā nikkhipati āsanā vā vuṭṭhāti kaṭacchuṃ vā parāmasati bhājanaṃ vā parāmasati ṭhapeti vā, dātukāmā viyā 'ti ṭhātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.2.26: bhikkhāya diyyamānāya vāmena hatthena saṃghāṭiṃ uccāretvā dakkhiṇena hatthena pattaṃ paṇāmetvā ubhohi hatthehi pattaṃ pariggahetvā bhikkhā paṭiggahetabbā,
pli-tv-kd18:5.2.30: sace kaṭacchuṃ vā parāmasati bhājanaṃ vā parāmasati ṭhapeti vā,
pli-tv-kd18:5.2.32: bhikkhāya dinnāya saṃghāṭiyā pattaṃ paṭicchādetvā sādhukaṃ ataramānena nivattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.1: yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, tena āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, avakkārapātiṃ dhovitvā upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ, pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.2: yo pacchā gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati, sace hoti bhuttāvaseso, sace ākaṅkhati, bhuñjitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.3: no ce ākaṅkhati, appaharite vā chaḍḍetabbaṃ appāṇake vā udake opilāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.4: tena āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmetabbaṃ, avakkārapātiṃ dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ, pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ paṭisāmetabbaṃ, bhattaggaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.5: yo passati pāniyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojaniyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ, tena upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.6: sac' assa hoti avisayhaṃ hatthavikārena, dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ, na ca tappaccayā vācā bhinditabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:5.3.7: idaṃ kho bhikkhave piṇḍacārikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ yathā piṇḍacārikehi bhikkhūhi vattitabban ti. ||3||5||
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū araññe viharanti,
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.2: te n' eva pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti, na paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti, na aggiṃ upaṭṭhāpenti, na araṇisahitaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti, na nakkhattapadāni jānanti, na disābhāgaṃ jānanti.
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.3: corā tattha gantvā te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.4: atthi bhante pāniyan ti. n' atth' āvuso
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.6: atthi bhante paribhojaniyan ti. n' atth' āvuso
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.10: atthi bhante araṇisahitan ti. n' atth' āvuso
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.17: n' ev' imesaṃ pāniyaṃ atthi, na paribhojaniyaṃ atthi, na aggi atthi, na araṇisahitaṃ atthi, na nakkhattapadāni jānanti, na disābhāgaṃ jānanti,
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.22: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd18:6.1.23: tena hi bhikkhave āraññakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā āraññakehi bhikkhūhi vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:6.2.1: āraññakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā kālass' eva uṭṭhāya, pattaṃ thavikāya pakkhipitvā, aṃse ālaggetvā, cīvaraṃ khandhe karitvā, upāhanā ārohitvā, dārubhaṇḍaṃ mattikābhaṇḍaṃ paṭisāmetvā, dvāravātapānaṃ thaketvā, senāsanā otaritabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:6.2.3: upāhanā omuñcitvā, nīcaṃ katvā, pappoṭhetvā, thavikāya pakkhipitvā, aṃse ālaggetvā, timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetvā, kāyabandhanaṃ . . . (ch. 5. 2) . . .
pli-tv-kd18:6.3.1: gāmato nikkhamitvā pattaṃ thavikāya pakkhipitvā, aṃse ālaggetvā, cīvaraṃ saṃharitvā, sīse karitvā, upāhanā ārohitvā gantabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:6.3.2: āraññakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ, paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ, aggi upaṭṭhāpetabbo, araṇisahitaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ, kattaradaṇḍo upaṭṭhāpetabbo, nakkhattapadāni uggahetabbāni
pli-tv-kd18:6.3.3: sakalāni vā ekadesāni vā, disākusalena bhavitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:6.3.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave āraññakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vattaṃ yathā āraññakehi bhikkhūhi vattitabban ti. ||3||6||
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ajjhokāse cīvarakammaṃ karonti,
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.2: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū paṭivāte p' aṅgaṇe senāsanaṃ pappoṭhesuṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū paṭivāte p' aṅgaṇe senāsanaṃ pappoṭhessanti,
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū paṭivāte p' aṅgaṇe senāsanaṃ pappoṭhenti, bhikkhū rajena okiriṃsū 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:7.1.12: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanavattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā bhikkhūhi senāsane vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.1: yasmiṃ vihāre viharati, sace so vihāro uklāpo hoti, sace ussahati, sodhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.2: vihāraṃ sodhentena paṭhamaṃ pattacīvaraṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.5: mañco nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.6: pīṭhaṃ nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭhapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.10: bhummattharaṇaṃ yathāpaññattaṃ sallakkhetvā nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.11: sace vihāre santānakaṃ hoti, ullokā paṭhamaṃ ohāretabbaṃ. ālokasandhikaṇṇabhāgā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.12: sace gerukaparikammakatā bhitti kaṇṇakitā hoti, colakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.13: sace kāḷavaṇṇakatā bhūmi kaṇṇakitā hoti, coḷakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.2.14: sace akatā hoti bhūmi, udakena parippositvā sammajjitabbā
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.1: bhummattharaṇaṃ ekamantaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.2: mañcapaṭipādakā ekamantaṃ otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.3: mañco ekamantaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.4: pīṭhaṃ ekamantaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.5: bhisibimbohanaṃ ekamantaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.6: nisīdanapaccattharaṇaṃ ekamantaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.7: kheḷamallako ekamantaṃ otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.8: apassenaphalakaṃ ekamantaṃ otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.10: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.11: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.3.12: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.1: sace puratthimā sarajā vātā vāyanti, puratthimā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.4: sace dakkhiṇā sarajā vātā vāyanti, dakkhiṇā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.5: sace sītakālo hoti, divā vātapānā vivaritabbā, rattiṃ thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.6: sace uṇhakālo hoti, divā vātapānā thaketabbā, rattiṃ vivaritabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.7: sace pariveṇaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, pariveṇaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.8: sace koṭṭhako uklāpo hoti, koṭṭhako sammajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.9: sace upaṭṭhānasālā uklāpā hoti, upaṭṭhānasālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.10: sace aggisālā uklāpā hoti, aggisālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.11: sace vaccakuṭī uklāpā hoti, vaccakuṭī sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.12: sace pāniyaṃ na hoti, pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.13: sace paribhojaniyaṃ na hoti, paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.14: sace ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.15: sace vuḍḍhena saddhiṃ ekavihāre viharati, na vuḍḍhaṃ anāpucchā uddeso dātabbo, na paripucchā dātabbā, na sajjhāyo kātabbo, na dhammo bhāsitabbo, na padīpo kātabbo, na padīpo vijjhāpetabbo, na vātapānā vivaritabbā, na vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.16: sace vuḍḍhena saddhiṃ ekacaṅkame caṅkamati, yena vuḍḍho tena parivattitabbaṃ, na ca vuḍḍho saṃghāṭikaṇṇena ghaṭṭetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:7.4.17: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanavattaṃ yathā bhikkhūhi senāsane vattitabban ti. ||4||7||
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jantāghare therehi bhikkhūhi nivāriyamānā anādariyaṃ paṭicca pahūtaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ āropetvā aggiṃ datvā dvāraṃ thaketvā dvāre nisīdanti,
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.2: bhikkhū uṇhābhitattā dvāraṃ alabhamānā mucchitā papatanti.
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jantāghare therehi bhikkhūhi . . . nisīdissanti . . .
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jantāghare therehi bhikkhūhi . . . nisīdanti . . .
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.12: na bhikkhave jantāghare therena bhikkhunā nivāriyamānena anādariyaṃ paṭicca pahūtaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ āropetvā aggi dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:8.1.14: na ca bhikkhave dvāraṃ thaketvā dvāre nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.1: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ jantāgharavattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā bhikkhūhi jantāghare vattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.2: yo paṭhamaṃ jantāgharaṃ gacchati, sace chārikā ussannā hoti, chārikā chaḍḍetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.3: sace jantāgharaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, jantāgharaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.4: sace paribhaṇḍaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, paribhaṇḍaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.7: sace jantāgharasālā uklāpā hoti, jantāgharasālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.8: cuṇṇaṃ sannetabbaṃ, mattikā temetabbā, udakadoṇikāya udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.9: jantāgharaṃ pavisantena mattikāya mukhaṃ makkhetvā purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharaṃ pavisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.12: sace ussahati, jantāghare therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ parikammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.13: jantāgharā nikkhamantena jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharā nikkhamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.14: sace ussahati, udake pi therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ parikammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.15: na therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato nahāyitabbaṃ, na uparito nahāyitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.17: yo pacchā jantāgharā nikkhamati, sace jantāgharaṃ cikkhallaṃ hoti, dhovitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.18: mattikādoṇikaṃ dhovitvā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ paṭisāmetvā, aggiṃ vijjhāpetvā, dvāraṃ thaketvā pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:8.2.19: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ jantāgharavattaṃ yathā bhikkhūhi jantāghare vattitabban ti. ||2||8||
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu brāhmaṇajātiko vaccaṃ katvā na icchati ācametuṃ
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.4: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.5: kim pana tvaṃ āvuso vaccaṃ katvā na ācamesīti.
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu vaccaṃ katvā na ācamessatīti.
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etaṃ atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.10: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu vaccaṃ katvā na ācamesīti.
pli-tv-kd18:9.1.14: na bhikkhave vaccaṃ katvā sati udake na ācametabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū vaccakuṭiyā yathāvuḍḍhaṃ vaccaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-kd18:10.1.2: navakā bhikkhū paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā vaccitā āgamenti,
pli-tv-kd18:10.1.6: saccaṃ bhagavā. vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd18:10.1.7: na bhikkhave vaccakuṭiyā yathāvuḍḍhaṃ vacco kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:10.1.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave āgatapaṭipāṭiyā vaccaṃ kātun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:10.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atisahasāpi vaccakuṭiṃ pavisanti, ubbhujitvāpi pavisanti, nitthunantāpi vaccaṃ karonti, dantakaṭṭhaṃ khādantāpi vaccaṃ karonti, bahiddhāpi vaccadoṇikāya vaccaṃ karonti, bahiddhāpi passāvadoṇikāya passāvaṃ karonti, passāvadoṇikāya pi kheḷaṃ karonti, pharusena pi kaṭṭhena avalekhanti, avalekhanakaṭṭham pi vaccakūpamhi pātenti, atisahasāpi nikkhamanti, ubbhujitvāpi nikkhamanti, capucapukārakam pi ācamenti, ācamanasarāvake pi udakaṃ sesenti.
pli-tv-kd18:10.2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atisahasāpi vaccakuṭiṃ pavisissanti . . . ācamanasarāvake pi udakaṃ sesessantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:10.2.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:10.2.9: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ vaccakuṭivattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā bhikkhūhi vaccakuṭiyā vattitabbaṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.1: yo vaccakuṭiṃ gacchati, bahi ṭhitena ukkāsitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.3: cīvaravaṃse vā cīvararajjuyā vā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā sādhukaṃ ataramānena vaccakuṭī pavisitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.22: sace avalekhanapidharo pūro hoti, avalekhanakaṭṭhaṃ chaḍḍetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.23: sace vaccakuṭī uklāpā hoti, vaccakuṭī sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.24: sace paribhaṇḍaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, paribhaṇḍaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.26: sace koṭṭhako uklāpo hoti, koṭṭhako sammajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.27: sace ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:10.3.28: idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ vaccakuṭivattaṃ yathā bhikkhūhi vaccakuṭiyā vattitabban ti. ||3||10||
pli-tv-kd18:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattanti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave saddhivihārikā upajjhāyesu na sammāvattissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.1.12: tena hi bhikkhave saddhivihārikānaṃ upajjhāyesu vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā saddhivihārikehi upajjhāyesu vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:11.2.3.1: kālass' eva uṭṭhāya upāhanā omuñcitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukhodakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.2.4: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.2.5: yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.2.7: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:11.3.1: sace upajjhāyo gāmaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saguṇaṃ katvā saṃghāṭiyo dātabbā, dhovitvā patto saudako dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.3.2: sace upajjhāyo pacchāsamaṇaṃ ākaṅkhati, timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādentena parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsetvā kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā saguṇaṃ katvā saṃghāṭiyo pārupitvā gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcitvā dhovitvā pattaṃ gahetvā upajjhāyassa pacchāsamaṇena hotabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.3.3: nātidūre gantabbaṃ, na accāsanne gantabbaṃ. pattapariyāpannaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd18:11.4.1: na upajjhāyassa bhaṇamānassa antarantarā kathā opātetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.4.3: nivattantena paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.4.4: sace cīvaraṃ sinnaṃ hoti, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbaṃ, na ca uṇhe cīvaraṃ nidahitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.4.6: cīvaraṃ saṃharantena caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.4.9: sace piṇḍapāto hoti upajjhāyo ca bhuñjitukāmo hoti, udakaṃ datvā piṇḍapāto upanāmetabbo. ||4||
pli-tv-kd18:11.5.2: bhuttāvissa udakaṃ datvā pattaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā vodakaṃ katvā muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.5.5: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.5.6: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.5.7: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.5.8: upajjhāyamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.5.9: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||5||
pli-tv-kd18:11.6.1: sace upajjhāyo nahāyitukāmo hoti, nahānaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.6.2: sace sītena attho hoti, sītaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.6.3: sace uṇhena attho hoti, uṇhaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.6.4: sace upajjhāyo jantāgharaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, cuṇṇaṃ sannetabbaṃ, mattikā temetabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya upajjhāyassa piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito gantvā jantāgharapīṭhaṃ datvā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ, cuṇṇaṃ dātabbaṃ, mattikā dātabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.6.6: jantāgharaṃ pavisantena mattikāya mukhaṃ makkhetvā purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharaṃ pavisitabbaṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-kd18:11.7.4: jantāgharā nikkhamantena jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharā nikkhamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.7.6: nahātena paṭhamataraṃ uttaritvā attano gattaṃ vodakaṃ katvā nivāsetvā upajjhāyassa gattato udakaṃ pamajjitabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saṃghāṭi dātabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.8.3.1: yasmiṃ vihāre upajjhāyo viharati, sace so vihāro uklāpo hoti, sace ussahati, sodhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.8.4: vihāraṃ sodhentena paṭhamaṃ pattacīvaraṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.1: mañco nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.2: pīṭhaṃ nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.6: bhummattharaṇaṃ yathāpaññattaṃ sallakkhetvā nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.7: sace vihāre santānakaṃ hoti, ullokā paṭhamaṃ ohāretabbaṃ. ālokasandhikaṇṇabhāgā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.8: sace gerukaparikammakatā bhitti kaṇṇakitā hoti, colakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.9: sace kāḷavaṇṇakatā bhūmi kaṇṇakitā hoti, colakaṃ temetvā pīḷetvā pamajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.9.10: sace akatā hoti bhūmi, udakena parippositvā sammajjitabbā
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.1: bhummattharaṇaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.2: mañcapaṭipādakā otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.3: mañco otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.4: pīṭhaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena asaṃghaṭṭantena kavāṭapiṭṭhaṃ atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.5: bhisibimbohanaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.6: nisīdanapaccattharaṇaṃ otāpetvā sodhetvā pappoṭhetvā atiharitvā yathāpaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.7: kheḷamallako otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.10.8: apassenaphalakaṃ otāpetvā pamajjitvā atiharitvā yathāṭṭhāne ṭhapetabbaṃ. ||10||
pli-tv-kd18:11.11.2: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.11.3: na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.11.4: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ. ||11||
pli-tv-kd18:11.12.1: sace puratthimā sarajā vātā vāyanti, puratthimā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.12.4: sace dakkhiṇā sarajā vātā vāyanti, dakkhiṇā vātapānā thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.12.5: sace sītakālo hoti, divā vātapānā vivaritabbā, rattiṃ thaketabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.12.6: sace uṇhakālo hoti, divā vātapānā thaketabbā, rattiṃ vivaritabbā. ||12||
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.1: sace pariveṇaṃ uklāpaṃ hoti, pariveṇaṃ sammajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.2: sace koṭṭhako uklāpo hoti, koṭṭhako sammajjitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.3: sace upaṭṭhānasālā uklāpā hoti, upaṭṭhānasālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.4: sace aggisālā uklāpā hoti, aggisālā sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.5: sace vaccakuṭī uklāpā hoti, vaccakuṭī sammajjitabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.6: sace pāniyaṃ na hoti, pāniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.7: sace paribhojaniyaṃ na hoti, paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.13.8: sace ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ. ||13||
pli-tv-kd18:11.14.1: sace upajjhāyassa anabhirati uppannā hoti, saddhivihārikena vūpakāsetabbā vūpakāsāpetabbā dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.14.2: sace upajjhāyassa kukkuccaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena vinodetabbaṃ vinodāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:11.14.3: sace upajjhāyassa diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena vivecetabbaṃ vivecāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā. ||14||
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.1: sace upajjhāyo garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti parivāsāraho, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.2: kinti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyassa parivāsaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.3: sace upajjhāyo mūlāya paṭikassanāraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.4: kinti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyaṃ mūlāya paṭikasseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.5: sace upajjhāyo mānattāraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.6: kinti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyassa mānattaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.7: sace upajjhāyo abbhānāraho hoti, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.15.8: kinti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyaṃ abbheyyā 'ti. ||15||
pli-tv-kd18:11.16.1: sace saṃgho upajjhāyassa kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.16.2: kinti nu kho saṃgho upajjhāyassa kammaṃ na kareyya lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.16.3: kataṃ vā pan' assa hoti saṃghena kammaṃ tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, saddhivihārikena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.16.4: kinti nu kho upajjhāyo sammāvatteyya lomaṃ pāteyya netthāraṃ vatteyya, saṃgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā 'ti. ||16||
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.1: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ dhovitabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena dhovitabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.2: kinti nu kho upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ dhoviyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.3: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ kātabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena kātabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.4: kinti nu kho upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ kariyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.5: sace upajjhāyassa rajanaṃ pacitabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena pacitabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.6: kinti nu kho upajjhāyassa rajanaṃ paciyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.7: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ rajitabbaṃ hoti, saddhivihārikena rajitabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.8: kinti nu kho upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ rajiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:11.17.9: cīvaraṃ rajantena sādhukaṃ samparivattakaṃ-samparivattakaṃ rajitabbaṃ na ca acchinne theve pakkamitabbaṃ. ||17||
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.1: na upajjhāyaṃ anāpucchā ekaccassa patto dātabbo, na ekaccassa patto paṭiggahetabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.2: na ekaccassa cīvaraṃ dātabbaṃ, na ekaccassa cīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.3: na ekaccassa parikkhāro dātabbo, na ekaccassa parikkhāro paṭiggahetabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.4: na ekaccassa kesā chedātabbā, na ekaccena kesā chedāpetabbā,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.5: na ekaccassa parikammaṃ kātabbaṃ, na ekaccena parikammaṃ kārāpetabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.6: na ekaccassa veyyāvacco kātabbo, na ekaccena veyyāvacco kārāpetabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.7: na ekaccassa pacchāsamaṇena hotabbaṃ, na ekacco pacchāsamaṇo ādātabbo,
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.8: na ekaccassa piṇḍapāto nīharitabbo, na ekaccena piṇḍapāto nīharāpetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.12: sace upajjhāyo gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo, vuṭṭhānassa āgametabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:11.18.13: idaṃ kho bhikkhave saddhivihārikānaṃ upajjhāyesu vattaṃ yathā saddhivihārikehi upajjhāyesu vattitabban ti. ||18||11||
pli-tv-kd18:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena upajjhāyā saddhivihārikesu na sammāvattanti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma upajjhāyā saddhivihārikesu na sammāvattissantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.1.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave upajjhāyā saddhivihārikesu na sammāvattantīti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.152: tena hi bhikkhave upajjhāyānaṃ saddhivihārikesu vattaṃ paññāpessāmi yathā upajjhāyehi saddhivihārikesu vattitabbaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.155: upajjhāyena bhikkhave saddhivihāriko saṃgahetabbo anuggahetabbo uddesena paripucchāya ovādena anusāsaniyā.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.156: sace upajjhāyassa patto hoti, saddhivihārikassa patto na hoti, upajjhāyena saddhivihārikassa patto dātabbo ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.157: kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa patto uppajjiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.158: sace upajjhāyassa cīvaraṃ hoti, saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ na hoti, upajjhāyena saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ dātabbaṃ ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.159: kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ uppajjiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.160: sace upajjhāyassa parikkhāro hoti, saddhivihārikassa parikkhāro na hoti, upajjhāyena saddhivihārikassa parikkhāro dātabbo ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.161: kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa parikkhāro uppajjiyethā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.162.1: sace saddhivihāriko gilāno hoti, kālass' eva uṭṭhāya dantakaṭṭhaṃ dātabbaṃ, mukhodakaṃ dātabbaṃ, āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.163: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.164: yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.166: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||3||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.167: sace saddhivihāriko gāmaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, kāyabandhanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saguṇaṃ katvā saṃghāṭiyo dātabbā, dhovitvā patto saudako dātabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.168: ettāvatā nivattissatīti āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.169: sace cīvaraṃ sinnaṃ hoti, muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbaṃ, na ca uṇhe cīvaraṃ nidahitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.171: cīvaraṃ saṃharantena caturaṅgulaṃ kaṇṇaṃ ussāretvā cīvaraṃ saṃharitabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.174: sace piṇḍapāto hoti saddhivihāriko ca bhuñjitukāmo hoti, udakaṃ datvā piṇḍapāto upanāmetabbo. ||4||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.176: bhuttāvissa udakaṃ datvā pattaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ aparighaṃsantena dhovitvā vodakaṃ katvā muhuttaṃ uṇhe otāpetabbo, na ca uṇhe patto nidahitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.178: pattaṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena pattaṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena heṭṭhāmañcaṃ vā heṭṭhāpīṭhaṃ vā parāmasitvā patto nikkhipitabbo, na ca anantarahitāya bhūmiyā patto nikkhipitabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.179: cīvaraṃ nikkhipantena ekena hatthena cīvaraṃ gahetvā ekena hatthena cīvaravaṃsaṃ vā cīvararajjuṃ vā pamajjitvā
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.180: pārato antaṃ orato bhogaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.181: saddhivihārikamhi vuṭṭhite āsanaṃ uddharitabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.182: sace so deso uklāpo hoti, so deso sammajjitabbo. ||5||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.183.1: sace saddhivihāriko nahāyitukāmo hoti, nahānaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.184: sace sītena attho hoti, sītaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.185: sace uṇhena attho hoti, uṇhaṃ paṭiyādetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.186: sace saddhivihāriko jantāgharaṃ pavisitukāmo hoti, cuṇṇaṃ sannetabbaṃ, mattikā temetabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya gantvā jantāgharapīṭhaṃ datvā cīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ, cuṇṇaṃ dātabbaṃ, mattikā dātabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.188: jantāgharaṃ pavisantena mattikāya mukhaṃ makkhetvā purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharaṃ pavisitabbaṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.192: jantāgharā nikkhamantena jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya purato ca pacchato ca paṭicchādetvā jantāgharā nikkhamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.194: nahātena paṭhamataraṃ uttaritvā attano gattaṃ vodakaṃ katvā nivāsetvā saddhivihārikassa gattato udakaṃ pamajjitabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, saṃghāṭi dātabbā, jantāgharapīṭhaṃ ādāya paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ, pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ. saddhivihāriko pāniyena pucchitabbo. ||7||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.195.1: yasmiṃ vihāre saddhivihāriko viharati, sace so vihāro uklāpo hoti, sace ussahati, sodhetabbo.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.196: vihāraṃ sodhentena paṭhamaṃ pattacīvaraṃ nīharitvā ekamantaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.200: ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ na hoti, ācamanakumbhiyā udakaṃ āsiñcitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.201.1: sace saddhivihārikassa anabhirati uppannā hoti, upajjhāyena vūpakāsetabbā vūpakāsāpetabbā dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.202: sace saddhivihārikassa kukkuccaṃ uppannaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena vinodetabbaṃ vinodāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.203: sace saddhivihārikassa diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena vivecetabbaṃ vivecāpetabbaṃ dhammakathā vāssa kātabbā. ||8||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.204: sace saddhivihāriko garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti parivāsāraho, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.205: kinti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikassa parivāsaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.206: sace saddhivihāriko mūlāya paṭikassanāraho hoti, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.207: kinti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikaṃ mūlāya paṭikasseyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.208: sace saddhivihāriko mānattāraho hoti, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.209: kinti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikassa mānattaṃ dadeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.210: sace saddhivihāriko abbhānāraho hoti, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.211: kinti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikaṃ abbheyyā 'ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.212: sace saṃgho saddhivihārikassa kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.213: kinti nu kho saṃgho saddhivihārikassa kammaṃ na kareyya lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.214: kataṃ vā pan' assa hoti saṃghena kammaṃ tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā, upajjhāyena ussukkaṃ kātabbaṃ
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.215: kinti nu kho saddhivihāriko sammāvatteyya lomaṃ pāteyya netthāraṃ vatteyya, saṃgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā 'ti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.216: sace saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ dhovitabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ dhoveyyāsīti,
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.217: ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ dhoviyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.218: sace saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ kātabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ kareyyāsīti,
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.219: ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ kariyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.220: sace saddhivihārikassa rajanaṃ pacitabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ paceyyāsīti,
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.221: ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa rajanaṃ paciyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.222: sace saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ rajitabbaṃ hoti, upajjhāyena ācikkhitabbaṃ evaṃ rajeyyāsīti,
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.223: ussukkaṃ vā kātabbaṃ kinti nu kho saddhivihārikassa cīvaraṃ rajiyethā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.226: sace saddhivihāriko gilāno hoti, yāvajīvaṃ upaṭṭhātabbo, vuṭṭhānassa āgametabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.227: idaṃ kho bhikkhave upajjhāyānaṃ saddhivihārikesu vattaṃ yathā upajjhāyehi saddhivihārikesu vattitabban ti. ||11||12|| tena kho pana samayena antevāsikā ācariyesu na sammāvattanti . . . (=ch. 11. Instead of upajjhāya read ācariya; instead of saddhivihārikā read antevāsika) . . . ||13|| tena kho pana samayena ācariyā antevāsikesu na sammāvattanti . . . (=ch. 12. Instead of upajjhāya, saddhivihārika,
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.228: read ācariya, antevāsika) . . . ||14|| vattakkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ aṭṭhamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthu pañcapaññāsa, vattaṃ cuddasa.
pli-tv-kd18:12.11.482: purato, there, na c' eva, parikammañ ca,
